ui.chat.credential_notice.armed: armed — add a space, then type or paste the secret
ui.chat.credential_notice.chip_chars: · {chars, plural, one {{chars, number, ::group-off} char} other {{chars, number, ::group-off} chars}}
ui.chat.credential_notice.chip_title: Credential #{index, number, ::group-off}, {chars, plural, one {# char} other {# chars}} — held in this message; its value cannot be read
ui.chat.credential_notice.cleared: Removed {key} (credential #{index, number, ::group-off}) from this message. Its value is gone — press {undoCap} to put it back, or paste it again after /credential to reuse it.
ui.chat.credential_notice.discarded: credential discarded — nothing was stored or sent
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span: masked — Enter opens the credential picker; type or paste the secret into this span
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span_dra: masked — Enter runs /credential, which needs an open conversation; type or paste the secret into this span
ui.chat.credential_notice.escape_held: Esc again discards it — still masked, Enter makes a pill
ui.chat.credential_notice.operator_move: Paste the value again after /credential to store it again.
ui.chat.credential_notice.typing: masked as you type — Enter makes a pill, Esc twice discards
ui.chat.credential_notice.unredacted: {length, plural, one {# character is} other {# characters are}} now PLAIN TEXT in the composer — Enter will expose {length, plural, one {it} other {them}}
